_comment: Per-weapon corrections for fields the WFCD export gets wrong or omits. Each entry is verified against Overframe's oracle by `node tools/calibrate.ts --battery`. Keep the note: it is the evidence.

Nataruk.note: Export reloadTime is 0.05 (nock animation only); the arsenal and Overframe both show 0.15.

Fulmin Prime.note: Export magazineSize is 8; Overframe reports 80, i.e. the export is a factor 10 short.

Felarx.note: Felarx reloads shell by shell: the export gives the per-shell time (3.7s), Overframe the full empty reload (6.5s). Sustained DPS needs the latter.

Grimoire.note: Export has no magazineSize and a 2s reloadTime; Overframe reports 10 rounds and a negligible reload.
